Good morning, everyone. Thanks for the updates. Let me synthesize what I'm hearing and lay out the final water-dispatch order.

Total water available today: 5,400 gallons. Two tanker loads, each up to 2,700 gallons.

- Clinic: 1,500 gallons (per Capt. Shah's medical amendment for the sterilization cycle)
- North Post: 1,200 gallons (standard)

Total required: 5,100 gallons. Remaining 300 gallons held as battalion reserve.

- Clinic: 1,500 gallons
- North Post: 1,200 gallons
- Total Load 1: 2,700 gallons (full tanker capacity)

- Maintenance Workshop: 1,200 gallons
- Observation Site East: 1,200 gallons
- Total Load 2: 2,400 gallons
- Battalion reserve: 300 gallons (retained at water point)

For Load 2 dispatch time: I need the standard one-way travel time to the workshop via the east service road detour to back-calculate from the 1250 required arrival. Lt. Grady, can you confirm the normal travel time so I can set the exact dispatch time? Or if anyone has that figure, I need it before I publish the final order.
